description: This file defines a PHP class 'Base64Url' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Utility'. The class provides methods for encoding and decoding data using a URL-safe base64 encoding scheme.

classes.name: Base64Url
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for URL-safe base64 encoding and decoding.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a string into a URL-safe base64 format.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 encoded string back to its original form.
